title: You Don't Need More Than Two Sets of Sheets
script: You do not need more than two sets of sheets. Here's why.
Most linen closets are packed with sheets nobody has used in years.
One: two sets per bed is plenty. One on the bed, and one in the wash.
Two: keep two towels per person, plus one set for guests.
Three: odd pillowcases and faded sheets? Animal shelters often welcome them.
Tonight, pull everything out of your linen closet, and put back only what fits that rule.
This is day four of my thirty-day declutter plan. The free checklist is linked in my profile.
